title: Kindness to Animals; Or, The Sin of Cruelty Exposed and Rebuked

description: "Kindness to Animals; Or, The Sin of Cruelty Exposed and Rebuked" by Charlotte Elizabeth is a moral treatise written in the mid-19th century.
longDescription: This book falls into the category of a didactic publication that aims to educate readers, particularly children, on the importance of compassion towards animals and the wrongness of cruelty.
